scope: Owned /tmp DSH home/profile, local HTTP MCP, actual TTY and manager component. No real user config edits, model/remote-provider requests, third-party patching, tag or publication.
problem: Legacy override migration previously refused changed snapshots but only displayed an error. Refreshing the original request without binding the reviewed target batch could silently migrate added targets or altered saved states.
behavior: Reuse the existing reload/default, backup retry, cancel selector. Migration retries preserve original entryId + serverName + saved disabled for the entire batch; changed target set/identity/state requires reloading and a new full review. Latest unrelated config/bytes remain intact.
